ASU offers merit-based scholarships for international first-year and transfer students. You are automatically considered when you apply for admission — no separate application is needed.
Tuition and fees vary depending on your program. You can estimate your total cost using ASU's cost of attendance calculator.

ASU may offer conditional admission to international applicants who meet the academic (aptitude) requirements but who are not proficient in English. Conditional admission gives international F-1 students three semesters to submit a passing TOEFL, IELTS or PTE score, or to successfully graduate from ASU Global Launch to be fully admitted to the university.
ASU offers several English proficiency exemptions for applicants who meet certain criteria.
A score of at least 550 (PBT) or 80 (iBT). ASU’s institutional code is 4007.
